answers.rationale: WAL is append-only with [4-byte length][encoded_op][4-byte CRC32] records; on open, replay_wal() re-applies committed ops and leaves uncommitted transactions with no COMMIT record discarded.

answers.rationale: Each WAL record includes a 4-byte CRC32 computed over the operation data; read_record_from() verifies it and returns a Storage error on mismatch, stopping replay.

answers.rationale: Each operator (SeqScan, IndexScan, Filter, Sort, etc.) fully materializes its result into a Vec before the next operator reads it; no lazy/streaming evaluation.

answers.rationale: WAL replay only applies changes from transactions that have a COMMIT record; a transaction with Insert WAL records but no COMMIT is treated as an uncommitted prefix and its changes are not applied.
